adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, `minimumTokenResponseSchema` is defined with computed keys like `[z.string().toString()]: z.number()` and `[z.string().optional().toString()]: z.unknown().optional()`. These do not create dynamic key validation in Zod; they evaluate to fixed, nonsensical property names at runtime (whatever `toString()` returns), so the schema does not actually validate “any numeric expiry field” and is not a meaningful minimum schema for sync-endpoint responses. Additionally, because `z.object(...)` defaults to stripping unknown keys (i.e., not erroring on extra fields), it won’t enforce validation beyond the explicitly defined properties. This makes the validation logic incorrect/unsafe relative to its stated intent and can lead to either overly-permissive or unexpectedly-failing parsing.
